== Biography ==
Jonet was born in 1653. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1150|James Glasgow]] and [[Whyte-2772|Bessie Whyte]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1150]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Jonet’s Edinburgh child index dated 24 February 1653 names James Glasgow and Bessie Whyt. The full James/Bessie Whyt couple matches the weaver’s 1649 marriage and the preceding Helen child.

Confident for the child’s paternity;2/24 February remains a separate date/event conflict.

Next useful test: Inspect the original parish page to distinguish birth and baptism or a copying error.
